method: Actual production WebGL. Select each catalogue entry, wait for model and shaders, draw to framebuffer. Hide only the selected parts and redraw immediately. Report pixels with summed RGB delta above 24. Disable road batching for the per-road comparison. No simulation time advances. The founder uses its own legacy scene.
geometryHash: Sorted list of part vertex/normal/uv/colour/index hashes, face counts and material names hashed with SHA-256. Each vertex channel quantised to 0.001.
